answer: Every identity must drop one anchor in a shared inlet, and the k-th anchor must hold the k-th ocean tide: the first needs 2 links, the second 4, the third 7, the fourth 11, so the k-th anchor costs the lazy-caterer number of links. Ten identities pay 230 links, the tenth alone 56; each anchor waits one tide per earlier anchor, so the hundredth fake waits 99 tides.
